prompt_en: A photorealistic 28 mm environmental editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult documentary traveler, whose general facial appearance, long dark softly waved hair, and natural skin texture draw only from the attached appearance reference, standing on a firm interdune flat at the lower left of a fog-fed coastal barchan field at dawn. The complete dune system dominates the frame. In one connected asymmetric wind-built dune structure, a broad gently rising windward stoss slope forms one side of the dune; a narrow continuous crest separates the gentle stoss side from the lee side in full oblique profile; a visibly steeper smooth slip face descends immediately behind the crest; fine sand ripples or short saltation traces align coherently across the stoss surface. A crosswind pulse drives ribbons of saltating sand up the stoss slope, over the crest, and into a small granular avalanche down the slipface. The oblique 28 mm frame keeps both dune faces connected within one readable profile. Wind-shaped asymmetry reads through crosslit relief and low airborne grains. Grazing amber light reveals transverse ripple relief while preserving natural sand texture. A thin near-ground veil of moving grains catches dawn light beside the crest. The traveler faces camera in three-quarter view, holding a saffron wind streamer and compact field notebook; her face remains unobstructed, her figure occupies about one fifth of the image, and her placement reveals the crest and both slopes. Low amber crosslight and thinning sea fog layer the distant dark escarpment. Natural documentary color, wind-realistic fabric and hair motion, broad depth of field, coherent human anatomy, physical contact, scale, and perspective.
